$schema_doc: Per-pin decoupling placement constraints. Each entry maps a capacitor reference to the IC pad it must be placed adjacent to, with a maximum centroid-to-pad distance in millimeters. Validated by tools/check_decoupling.py against the routed PCB. Edit this file when adding or removing decoupling caps; do NOT let the PCB silently drift away from these requirements. See hardware/pcb/v2/tools/README.md for usage and the rationale behind each entry.

W25Q16JV DS + universal RP2040 reference practice: 100nF at flash VCC
Crystal load cap for XIN side. The critical short-trace path is Y1.pad->C5->GND, not U3->C5; the Y1->U3 trace is a separate constraint. 15 pF = 2*(10 pF CL - 2.5 pF stray).
Crystal load cap for XOUT side. Y1.3 is the Xo signal pad on ABM8-272-T3 (pads 1,3 are signals; 2,4 are case GND). Schematic uses Device:Crystal_GND24 to get the diagonal signal topology right.
RP2040 DS §2.9.2 DVDD_1V1 bulk at VREG_VOUT pin 45 (Pico reference places 1uF bulk here)
POR filter on RUN per Pico reference schematic (Pico-Datasheet §2.2); smooths power-up ramp so the RP2040 releases reset cleanly. Must be close to U3.26 to keep trace loop short.
